title: Proof Native — Reference workbench skeleton, native window chrome

nativeImplementation.navigation: User-approved reference skeleton: repository tab strip made from actual32pt row segments inside each native column; no overlay or root safeAreaInset; combined 44pt Changes/Commit/History rail and ideal280pt file pane; central Diff and responsive Context inspector; sidebar-local GeometryReader bounds retained
nativeImplementation.windowToolbar: Native unified toolbar; fixed260pt repository identity with explicit titleAndIcon branch; automatic title removed on15+ and retained NSWindow title hidden for fallback; Context/refresh only; small bordered actions in56pt file header

surfaces.selectionAndManualReview: SwiftUI Color.blue; review remains distinct from staging
surfaces.proofMark: Original Proof blue, RGB 49/91/206 (#315BCE), with white review stroke and brackets

nativeImplementation.fonts: SF system / AppKit monospaced system font
nativeImplementation.icons: SF Symbols plus the original assets/proof.svg mark reproduced as native vector geometry

materialPolicy.macOS26And27: System-native window/navigation materials where supported; file-header actions use small bordered controls, not explicit glass pills; no fabricated blur
materialPolicy.macOS13To15: Native compatibility appearance, not Liquid Glass; minimum deployment remains macOS13; runtime on older systems untested
materialPolicy.code: Solid document background; no simulated blur or glass

nativeImplementation.motion: No added decorative entrance motion; retain system behavior and Reduce Motion

validation.status: SHIP: four native Changes preview layouts pass geometry assertions and visual inspection; not full interaction, old-OS runtime, feature parity or user aesthetic acceptance
validation.reference: User-provided original screenshot inspected for structure only; private identifiers/content excluded from documentation
validation.required: Final actual app-window captures inspected in light/dark at compact1024x674 and wide1440x677
validation.fixture: Preview · illustrative repository · no Git operations
validation.capturePlan: Completed four actual captures. Requested wide1440x900 constrained to1440x677; no display/security changes or scaled proxies.

treeBehavior.default: Compressed single-folder chains; stops at files or branches
treeBehavior.identity: side + path; staged and unstaged versions remain separate
treeBehavior.search: Filters by path and expands matching groups/folders
treeBehavior.collapse: Local group/folder state, overridden by active search
treeBehavior.flatList: Full path in a single line
treeBehavior.rowMetadata: Status letter, loaded-content manual-review checkmark, full-path and rename-source tooltip
treeBehavior.originalComparison: Original FileTree estimates file rows at 32px and group rows at 36px; native file content is 32pt, group/folder content 30pt with 32pt minimum List rows. Identity restoration is not a pixel-identical port.

reviewCoverage.source: Only Rust bridge-returned loadedDiffs snapshots in production; Preview is synthetic and separately labeled
reviewCoverage.display: Reviewed / total hunks in loaded snapshots, plus loaded / total files
reviewCoverage.unknown: Unloaded files are unknown, not reviewed
reviewCoverage.invalidation: Cache cleared on open, reload/refresh and view change; selected entry removed before reloading; no continuous background-validity guarantee
reviewCoverage.safety: Manual review remains content-bound and separate from explicit Stage/Unstage confirmations, trust, stale-write checks and cancellation

scope.included: Restore approved screenshot layout with a real single-active repository tab, navigation rail, compact file pane, central Diff and truthful read-only Context; existing Commit/History retained
scope.unchanged: Original Web/Tauri implementation and guidance; Rust backend
notImplemented: Full History graph and comparison tabs
AI/session context and reported validation results

nativeImplementation.repositoryTabBehavior: Single active tab only; real close guards unsaved commit draft and clears repository state; open replaces current repository. Not multi-repository support.

contextInspector.responsive: 260pt column in Changes at window width >=1200pt when visible; toolbar toggles column, or opens 300x470pt popover below threshold
fields: Opaque snapshot ID, not Git commit hash
contextInspector.limits: Read-only loaded snapshot; refresh required for latest content. No invented AI findings, validation success, sessions or real-time update claims.

narrative.northStar: Restore Proof’s approved workbench skeleton; native materials support, not replace, its structure.
narrative.overview: The user-approved reference restores repository tabs, a compact navigation rail, files, central Diff and responsive Context. Current implementation truthfully supports one active repository and loaded-snapshot context only. This supersedes the earlier no-rail composition while leaving original Web/Tauri untouched; final Changes layout captures pass; broader acceptance remains separate.
keyCharacteristics: Native unified toolbar limited to repository identity/context/refresh

rules.name: Navigation material stops at code
rules.body: System glass belongs to navigation and controls, never the code document.

dos: Follow the approved reference structure without copying its private content.
Keep single-repository and loaded-snapshot limits explicit.
Preserve native keyboard, copy/find, trust, draft and stale-write protections.
Use fresh native captures for this revision; distinguish directional approval from render acceptance.
donts: Do not claim multiple repository tabs work concurrently.
Do not fake validation, AI results, sessions or automatic freshness.
Do not move file actions back into large global glass pills.
Do not fake glass or make code translucent.
Do not treat previous screenshots or successful builds as current visual approval.
